description: This file defines the ValidationException class, a custom exception used in the org.apache.ofbiz.minilang package to indicate invalid mini-language elements. It extends MiniLangException and includes additional context such as the method and XML element involved.

classes.name: ValidationException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating invalid mini-language elements, with contextual information about the method and XML element involved.

methods.name: ValidationException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message, method, and XML element context.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Overrides the default getMessage to include details about the method and XML element associated with the exception.
